strings.settings_description: Choose your editor and display preferences.
strings.index_search: Search MD and TXT files across Windows
strings.translate_help: To use Edge translation, hold Shift and right-click the document, then choose Translate.
strings.welcome_desc: Open a document to browse its folder.
strings.browse_desc: Choose a folder or document on the left.
strings.no_items: No folders or documents to display.

strings.tutorial_open_desc: Open an MD or TXT file. Its folder appears in the sidebar.
strings.tutorial_browse_desc: Choose a folder or document here. Use .. to move to the parent folder.
strings.tutorial_search_desc: Search this folder, or use the icon to search across Windows.
strings.tutorial_sidebar_desc: Click to pin or hide the sidebar. When hidden, hover near the left edge to peek.
strings.tutorial_resize_desc: Drag this border to resize the sidebar. You can also focus it and use the arrow keys.
strings.tutorial_editor_desc: Choose a detected editor. Set it as default to open documents directly next time.
strings.tutorial_settings_desc: Change the language, dark mode, search scope, default editor, and optional tabs.
strings.tutorial_tools_desc: Adjust the text size or print the document. Ctrl + mouse wheel also changes the size.
